name: Sasha Kovalenko
headline: 54, lawyer on medical leave, trust fund manager, Lviv
description: Sasha, a Ukrainian lawyer on medical leave after a bicycle accident, is slowly regaining mobility while managing a trust fund left by their grandfather. Every morning they review physical-therapy exercises with the same care they used to redlining contracts, noting each improvement in a ledger. They have also started reorganizing the law firm's client files from home, even though their doctor told them to rest.
